## Execution tips

- Approach from above and grip middle sections of opposite bread sides, avoiding rounded corners and top edges. Open slightly wider than the selected section and confirm the fingers straddle it before closing to reduce pushing or slipping.
- During transport, keep the bread high enough to clear the basket rim and leave room for the gripper and bread to pass around the bottle in the center. Avoid collisions that could cause a drop or push the basket out of position.
- The basket opening is narrow. Orient the bread outside it in ample space, aligning its longer edge with the oval basket's length to reduce wall collisions during entry. If clearance is sufficient, repeated reorientation is unnecessary.
- With bread already in the basket, select a securely supported spot beside or above it without pushing it toward the rim during lowering. Release near the support surface with finger-opening clearance to reduce bouncing out or gripper collisions with basket walls.
